definitions.explanation: Having a close biological or taxonomic relationship, such as species within the same genus or family. Primarily used in biology and natural science contexts.
Having a close familial or blood relationship. Used in formal or literary contexts to describe family ties.

examples.english: Wolves are a species closely related to dogs.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦バラ{科|か}→バラ科：29578_baraka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近縁|きんえん}⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}される→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧。
examples.english: This plant is classified as a species closely related to the rose family.

examples.japanese: DNA⟦{解析|かいせき}→解析：16075_kaiseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}われていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{近縁|きんえん}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: DNA analysis revealed that organisms previously thought to belong to different groups are actually closely related.

examples.japanese: {近縁|きんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
{近縁|きんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親族|しんぞく}→親族：14199_shinzoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦{知|し}らせた→知る：00458_shiru⟧。

{近縁|きんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間柄|あいだがら}→間柄：19442_aidagara⟧であって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{会|あ}っていない→会う：00482_au⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{疎遠|そえん}→疎遠：08372_soen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even close relatives can drift apart if they haven't seen each other for many years.

notes:
USAGE:
{近縁|きんえん} is composed of {近|きん} (close) and ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧ (relation, connection). The biological sense (sense 1) is by far the more common usage in modern Japanese.

Note: Do not confuse with ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧ (no smoking), which has the same reading but completely different kanji and meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近縁|きんえん}⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (closely related species)
- {近縁|きんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧ (closely related organisms)
- {近縁|きんえん}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (close taxonomic relationship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {類縁|るいえん} — taxonomic affinity (more technical)
- ⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧ — relatives (everyday word for family relations)
